video_title: 100 Hours in LA as an NBA Player

quotes.speaker: NBA Player
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of early training and consistency in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I'm training my mind, my body now, and yeah, just cross the day with me.
quotes.quote: We back in LA, training at the Excel facility. 6:30 in the morning, come in, get it in early, and just assimilate the season. Because in the season, you got to wake up early anyway. So, I'm training my mind, my body now, and yeah, just cross the day with me.

quotes.speaker: NBA Player
quotes.summary_phrase: Focusing on small, consistent improvements in diet and training
quotes.excerpt: I'm not looking for a huge margin, just a little better each day.
quotes.quote: I'm trying to be elite, not just good. I don't even need to be elite, I want to be elite. So, you got to push a little bit harder. That's the goal, do it now, every day. Push it, push it, push it. I want to get a little bit better each day. I'm not looking for a huge margin, just a little better each day. And over time, after you get the separation.

quotes.speaker: NBA Player
quotes.summary_phrase: Developing off-the-dribble skills for late-game situations
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to focus on a lot of off-the-dribble, I'm going to focus on miscellaneous shots.
quotes.quote: Today I'm going to focus on a lot of off-the-dribble, I'm going to focus on miscellaneous shots, just wherever my creative mind can bring in. Because I think that's what really pushes the greats that I watched, when they get into a mode where they can't be stopped, like in the third quarter, fourth quarter, playoffs, when you know all the plays. So, I'm excited for that, getting to work.

quotes.speaker: NBA Player
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of recovery and consistency for NBA players
quotes.excerpt: All the young hoopers out there, recovery is key. You can't do this without recovering.
quotes.quote: All the young hoopers out there, recovery is key. You can't do this without recovering. Don't try, it ain't going to work. Most of the surrounding soft tissue, like what types of stuff are you guys still focusing on? Soft tissue, and then just, yeah, just whatever. Okay, we'll do maybe a little bit of just range of motion work. Yeah, I'll do that. I'll I'll switch my gloves out. I'll take you through range first, just kind of nice and easy.

quotes.speaker: NBA Player
quotes.summary_phrase: Maintaining a rigorous training schedule during the off-season
quotes.excerpt: I'm trying to get in shape, ramp up, so when the lights come on for real, I'm ready.
quotes.quote: I'm trying to get in shape, ramp up, so when the lights come on for real, I'm ready. Right now, I'm working on my game, trying to just stay in shape, competing, trying to lift the gym up, talking shit, just doing everything, having fun, competing. That's what I do.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards on his training goals and recovery
quotes.excerpt: I'm really just trying to maximize my reps, shoot while I'm fatigued, simulate a game-like situation
quotes.quote: Second workout of the day. I'm really just trying to maximize my reps, shoot while I'm fatigued, simulate a game-like situation, and just put the groundwork down for greatness. That's pretty much what I'm trying to accomplish today. I'm tired though, legs are tired, can't feel my legs, but make shots now while I'm tired. When I recover, that's how I will get separation.

quotes.speaker: Trainer
quotes.summary_phrase: Trainer discussing the importance of clear communication with the dog
quotes.excerpt: Make your communication very clear to him. Make it be either black or white, no gray area.
quotes.quote: The first month when he stays with you, he's living with you, make your communication very clear to him. Make it be either black or white, no gray area. Good job for doing this. There has to be a very fine balance between the two.

quotes.speaker: Trainer
quotes.summary_phrase: Trainer explaining the three types of rewards for dog training
quotes.excerpt: There's three main types of rewards. Food is definitely one of them, toys is definitely another one.
quotes.quote: There's three main types of rewards. Food is definitely one of them, toys is definitely another one, and then the love and affection that we give him. So when he works for us, when he does his obedience, that's technically him working for us. He gets paid by any one of those three paychecks.
